info.title: NotedThat HTTP API
info.description:
The versioned machine API of a NotedThat server. Paths are relative to the server URL, `/api/v1`.

This document is generated from the server's code and is authoritative for paths, parameters, schemas and status codes. `docs/API.md` explains behaviour; where the two disagree, `docs/API.md` is wrong.

Every response carries `x-request-id`, echoing the request's when it sent one.

get.summary: List the knowledge bases the caller may see.
get.description:
Anonymous callers see those whose access policy grants `anyone` something;
an anonymous caller who can see none is answered `401`, not an empty list.

200.description: The knowledge bases the caller may see.

get.summary: List one page of a knowledge base's objects.
get.description:
Only the objects the caller's `list` grant spans are returned. A page can
come back short of `limit` with `truncated` set; keep paging.

parameters.name: kb_slug
parameters.description: The knowledge base.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Only keys starting with this prefix.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Page size. `0` or absent is `100`; a value larger than `1000` is
accepted and clamped to `1000`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page.

post.description:
Hybrid: dense embeddings and keyword matching, fused by rank. Hits are
limited to keys the caller's `search` grant spans. The body is at most
64 KiB.

parameters.name: kb_slug
parameters.description: The knowledge base.

get.summary: Report one knowledge base's search-index health.
get.description:
Answered with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Reachable by whoever would see the
knowledge base listed.

parameters.name: kb_slug
parameters.description: The knowledge base.

post.summary: Start a reconciliation pass over one knowledge base.
post.description:
Compares storage against the search index and re-indexes what differs, in
the background; the result appears as `last_reconcile` in
`GET /knowledgebases/{kb_slug}/index`. Only the deployment's service token
may ask: any other credential is `403`. Available on the `s3` backend only;
elsewhere `404`.

parameters.name: kb_slug
parameters.description: The knowledge base.

get.summary: Subscribe to a knowledge base's change events.
get.description:
A server-sent event stream (`text/event-stream`). The first frame is
`retry: 3000` and the comment `:subscribed`; each event after it is

```text
id: <position>
event: object.written | object.deleted | object.indexed | object.index_failed
data: <ObjectEvent as JSON>
```

with a `keep-alive` comment every 15 seconds while idle. Only events for
keys the caller may `list` are sent. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` to
resume after the last event received. See the `ObjectEvent` schema for the
`data` payload. A server with events disabled answers `404`.

parameters.name: kb_slug
parameters.description: The knowledge base.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Only events for keys starting with this prefix.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description:
Only this kind: `written`, `deleted`, `indexed` or `index_failed`. An
`object.` prefix is accepted.

parameters.name: mime
parameters.description:
Only events carrying this content type, exactly or as `type/*`. A
deletion carries none, so never matches.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after this position: the `id` of the last event received.

200.description: The event stream. Each `data` line is an `ObjectEvent`.

get.summary: Read an object, whole or in part.
get.description:
`Range: bytes=…` selects bytes (one range only); `Range: lines=a-b` selects
lines, 1-based and inclusive, and answers with `Content-Range: lines a-b/N`
and `X-Content-Range-Bytes`. A text content type is served with
`; charset=utf-8`.

parameters.name: kb_slug
parameters.description: The knowledge base.

parameters.name: object_path
parameters.description:
The object's path within the knowledge base, percent-encoded as one segment:
`docs/rfc/7231.md` is sent as `docs%2Frfc%2F7231.md`. The server also accepts
its `/` unencoded, which is how it writes `Location`.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: `bytes=<first>-<last>`, `bytes=<first>-`, `bytes=-<suffix>`, or `lines=<first>-<last>`.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: Serve the range only if this entity tag or date still describes the object; otherwise the whole object, `200`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Answer `412` unless the object's entity tag is one of these, or `*`.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Answer `304` if the object's entity tag is one of these, or `*`.

parameters.name: If-Modified-Since
parameters.description: Answer `304` unless the object changed after this HTTP date.

parameters.name: If-Unmodified-Since
parameters.description: Answer `412` if the object changed after this HTTP date.

X-Content-Range-Bytes.description: On a line range: the bytes it spans, `<first>-<last>/<size>`, or `*/<size>` for an empty insert point.

X-Insert-Offset.description: On an empty line range: the byte offset where lines would be inserted.

put.description:
The body is stored as is, with its `Content-Type`. Writing
`.notedthat/manifest.json` is validated as a manifest first.

parameters.name: kb_slug
parameters.description: The knowledge base.

parameters.name: object_path
parameters.description:
The object's path within the knowledge base, percent-encoded as one segment:
`docs/rfc/7231.md` is sent as `docs%2Frfc%2F7231.md`. The server also accepts
its `/` unencoded, which is how it writes `Location`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description:
Proceed only if the object's current entity tag is one of these, or `*` for any
existing object; otherwise `412`.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: `*`: proceed only if the object does not exist; otherwise `412`.

parameters.name: X-NotedThat-Source
parameters.description: `mcp` attributes the change events to the MCP server. Informational.

head.description:
The headers `GET` would send, without the body, except `Content-Type`:
`HEAD` sends it only when one was stored, where `GET` falls back to
`application/octet-stream`. `Range` is ignored.

parameters.description: The knowledge base.

parameters.name: object_path
parameters.description:

`docs/rfc/7231.md` is sent as `docs%2Frfc%2F7231.md`. The server also accepts

parameters.name: If-None-Match

Content-Type.description: As stored; absent when none was stored.

patch.description:
Either `Content-Range` names the bytes or lines the body replaces, and
`If-Match` is required; or `NT-Patch-Mode: append` appends the body, and
`If-Match` is optional. The two are mutually exclusive. `If-Match` must be a
single entity tag. The object must be no larger than the server's patchable
size limit.

parameters.name: kb_slug
parameters.description: The knowledge base.

parameters.name: object_path
parameters.description:
The object's path within the knowledge base, percent-encoded as one segment:
`docs/rfc/7231.md` is sent as `docs%2Frfc%2F7231.md`. The server also accepts
its `/` unencoded, which is how it writes `Location`.

parameters.name: Content-Range
parameters.description: `bytes <first>-<last>/*` or `lines <first>-<last>/*`: the span the body replaces.

parameters.name: NT-Patch-Mode
parameters.description: `append`: append the body.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The object's current entity tag. Required with `Content-Range`; `*` and lists are refused `400`.

parameters.name: X-NotedThat-Source
parameters.description: `mcp` attributes the change events to the MCP server. Informational.

post.description: Finds `old_string` in the object at `object_path` and replaces it with `new_string`, atomically against `If-Match`, which is required and must be a single entity tag. The object must be no larger than the server's patchable size limit.

get.description: Public, like `/llms.txt`: it describes the routes and carries no data.

AmbiguousMatchError.description: The error envelope of a replace whose `old_string` occurs more than once.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Its wording is not part of the contract.

request_id.description: The request's id, the same value as the `x-request-id` response header.

ConceptMetadata.description: Metadata identifying the OKF concept containing a search chunk.

concept_id.description: Bundle-relative document path without the `.md` extension.

type.description: OKF concept type, including custom types.

resource.description: Resource identifier associated with the concept.

tags.description: Tags used to discover the concept.

Error.description: The error envelope every JSON error response carries.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Its wording is not part of the contract.

request_id.description: The request's id, the same value as the `x-request-id` response header.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error code. Clients branch on this, never on `message`.

EventSource.description: Which surface made the change, or which part of the server reports it. Informational: any client can claim `mcp`. `fs-watch` and `reconcile` are changes the server detected in storage; `indexer` reports the outcome of indexing, never a change to the bytes.

object_key.description: The object that failed; absent unless the caller may list it.

summary.description:
The pipeline's own error, first line; absent unless the caller's `list`
grant spans the whole knowledge base.

state.description: The worst condition that holds, from `healthy` up to `failed`.

pending.description: Index jobs queued for this knowledge base and not yet taken by the worker.

queue.description: The indexing queue, which every knowledge base shares.

worker.description: Whether the indexing worker is running.

last_indexed_at.description:
When the worker last completed a job for this knowledge base, RFC 3339;
`null` if never.

oneOf.description: The most recent indexing failure; `null` if none.
The most recent reconciliation pass; `null` if none has run.

IndexStateName.description:
The index's state, most severe first. `failed`: the most recent outcome was
a failure, or the worker is gone. `stale`: changes may have gone unobserved,
and the pass that repairs that has not completed. `backpressured`: writes
were refused `503` recently, or the queue is full now. `indexing`: work is
queued or in progress. `healthy`: nothing pending, nothing failed since the
last success, nothing lost.

KbListEntry.description:
One knowledge base: the slug the routes take, and the manifest's display
name and description, so an agent can choose where to search before it
searches.

display_name.description: The manifest's display name; the slug when it has none.

description.description: The manifest's description, when it has one.

KbListResponse.description: The knowledge bases the caller may see.

KbSlug.description: A knowledge base slug: 1 to 40 of `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`, not starting or ending with `-`.

allOf.description: What happened, with the stamp of the bytes it concerns.

source.description: Which surface made or detected the change, or reports the outcome.

occurred_at.description: When the server published it, RFC 3339 in UTC.

ObjectEvent.description: One change to one object, or the indexer's verdict on it.

oneOf.description:
The key was created or its bytes were replaced. Neither the API nor
storage distinguish the two, so neither does the event.

etag.description: The `ETag` of the bytes the event describes, quoted per RFC 7232.

oneOf.description:
The indexer finished an upsert or refresh of the key: `chunks` points
now represent the bytes stamped `etag`, and a search may find them.

The size and mtime are not repeated: the `object.written` carrying the
same `etag` already said what the bytes look like, and a subscriber
correlates the two by that stamp.

etag.description:
The `ETag` the indexer read with `HEAD` and verified on the stream
it staged — the version that is in the index.

mime.description:
Content type as `HEAD` reported it or, when `HEAD` reported none
or one naming no media type (such as `;charset=utf-8`), the type
the key's suffix names.

chunks.description: Points representing the object after this pass.

oneOf.description:
The indexer gave up on an upsert or refresh of the key; the index does
not hold this version.

etag.description: The `ETag` `HEAD` reported; absent when the failure came first.

mime.description:
Content type as `HEAD` reported it or, when `HEAD` reported none
or one naming no media type (such as `;charset=utf-8`), the type
the key's suffix names; absent when the failure came first.

summary.description:
The pipeline's own error, first line, at most 200 characters — the
same string the index health view reports. Always set when
published; the HTTP stream withholds it from a subscriber whose
`list` grant does not span the whole knowledge base, so a received
event may lack it.

ObjectEventKind.description:
What happened to the key.

Serialised with an `event` tag so the JSON payload is self-describing on
its own, without the SSE `event:` field or the broker subject around it.

ObjectKey.description: An object's key: its path within the knowledge base, without a leading `/`.

ObjectListResponse.description: One page of a knowledge base's objects.

truncated.description: Whether more objects follow; fetch them with `next_cursor`.

next_cursor.description: The `cursor` of the next page; `null` on the last one.

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata about a single stored object, returned by HEAD and LIST responses.

key.description: The object's key (path within the KB bucket, without leading slash).

last_modified.description: Last-modified Unix timestamp (seconds), if the backend provides one.

content_type.description: Content-Type as stored (echoed from the original PUT).

etag.description:
Opaque `ETag` from the backend, wrapped in quotes per RFC 7232 §2.3
(e.g., `"\"abc123\""`). Emitted verbatim in HTTP responses.

ObjectPath.description: An object's path within the knowledge base, without a leading `/`.

QueueView.description: The shared indexing queue at this moment.

capacity.description: Jobs the queue holds; a write finding it full is answered `503`.

ReconcileStarted.description: The `202` body: which knowledge base, and that the pass has started.

scope.description: The prefix the pass walked; absent when it walked the whole base.

objects_on_disk.description:
Objects the pass found in storage. Present with the other counts, only
when the caller may list what the pass walked.

unchanged.description: Objects already indexed from exactly these bytes.

changed.description: Objects new to the index, or indexed from different bytes.

orphaned.description: Keys the index holds that storage no longer has.

Refusal.description: The error envelope of a request the server refused before handling it: at its limit of requests in flight, or out of time.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Its wording is not part of the contract.

request_id.description: The request's id, when one had been assigned.

ReplaceBody.description: A text replacement within one object.

old_string.description: The text to find. Must not be empty.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence. Otherwise exactly one must exist.

total_bytes.description: The object's new size in bytes.

SearchFilter.description: Filters applied to a search. Every field is optional; they are AND-composed. Unknown keys are rejected with `400`.

object_key_prefix.description: Only return hits whose `object_key` starts with this prefix (client-side post-filter).

mime.description:
Only return hits with this media type (e.g. `"text/markdown"`). Parameters
such as `charset`, and case, are ignored on both sides of the match. A chunk
indexed before that normalisation (#286) is matched only by its exact raw
type, until its object is indexed again.

concept_type.description: Only return hits with exactly this OKF concept type.

heading_path_prefix.description: Only return hits whose `heading_path` array starts with these segments (prefix match).

updated_after.description: Only return hits with `mtime >= updated_after` (unix seconds).

updated_before.description: Only return hits with `mtime <= updated_before` (unix seconds).

tags.description: Only return hits tagged with at least one of these tags.

SearchHit.description:
One hit in a search result set.

`byte_start` and `byte_end` are the byte offsets in the original object
that delimit this chunk. Use them with a `Range: bytes=<byte_start>-<byte_end-1>`
header against `GET /api/v1/knowledgebases/{kb_slug}/{path}` to fetch the exact bytes.

object_key.description: The object's key (its path within the knowledge base).

byte_start.description: Byte offset of the start of this chunk in the original object.

byte_end.description: Byte offset of the end (exclusive) of this chunk in the original object.

heading_path.description: Heading hierarchy at the location of this chunk (may be empty).

score.description: Reciprocal-rank-fusion score. Higher is better. Not a probability.

preview.description: Preview text — a UTF-8-safe truncation of the chunk to at most 500 characters.

oneOf.description: OKF concept metadata, absent for ordinary Markdown documents.

SearchRequest.description: A hybrid (dense + keyword) search over one knowledge base. Unknown keys are rejected with `400`.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return. Clamped to `[1, 50]`. Defaults to `10`.

SearchResponse.description: The ranked hits of a search.

hits.description: The ranked list of search hits (may be empty).

WorkerState.description: Whether the indexing worker is running.

BackendUnavailable.description: `backend_unavailable`: a backend or queue is unavailable or full, or the server is at its limit of requests in flight. Retry after `Retry-After`. A write answered this way may already be stored; repeat it.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed: `invalid_request` or `malformed_range`. A query string the server cannot parse at all is answered `400` with a plain-text body instead.

Conflict.description: `conflict`: the request conflicts with work in progress.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden`: the credential is valid and the knowledge base's access policy does not grant this operation. An anonymous caller is answered `404` instead.

GatewayTimeout.description: `request_timeout`: the request did not complete within the server's timeout.

Gone.description: `gone`: the events after `Last-Event-ID` are no longer retained. Resubscribe without it.

NotFound.description: `not_found`: no such knowledge base or object — or one an anonymous caller may not see, which reads identically.

NotModified.description: The object has not changed. No body.

Last-Modified.description: The object's modification time, when it has no entity tag.

PayloadTooLarge.description: `payload_too_large`: the body exceeds the route's limit.

PreconditionFailed.description: `precondition_failed`: a conditional header's precondition did not hold.

PreconditionRequired.description: `precondition_required`: this write must be conditional; send `If-Match`.

RangeNotSatisfiable.description: The range lies outside the object. No body.

Content-Range.description: `bytes */<size>`, or `lines */<line count>` for a line range.

X-Content-Range-Bytes.description: `*/<size in bytes>`, on a line range only.

RequestTimeout.description: `request_timeout`: the request body stopped arriving for longer than the server's idle limit.

Unauthorized.description: `unauthorized`: no credential where one is required, or one that did not verify.

WWW-Authenticate.description: `Bearer resource_metadata="…"`, when the deployment publishes OAuth protected resource metadata.

UnprocessableReplace.description: `no_match`: `old_string` does not occur; or `ambiguous_match`: it occurs more than once and `replace_all` is false.

bearer.bearerFormat: service token or OIDC access token (JWT)
bearer.description: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: the deployment's service token, or an access token from the configured OIDC issuer. A malformed or unverified credential is always `401`, never treated as anonymous.
